basis: real Claude Code 2.1.308 sessions, forced 5-minute cache (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M), usage fields as recorded; mechanism checks, not a saving claim

guard.interactive: the $.ui.ask dialog shows the idle time, the context size and the rewrite price, with Send anyway, Compact first and Cancel

compactFirst.note: compaction ran, then the prompt was sent; a 3-message chat cannot shrink

guard.scriptedPrompts: the guard stays silent for SDK and -p prompts by design

keepalive.why: the $.model.fork ping reads the system prompt and tools but rewrites the message part under its own key, so it does not restart the chat's cache lifetime, and a failed ping costs a cache write. The next real request after a ping still read only its own earlier cache.
keepalive.interactiveNote: in an interactive run no ping fired in 5 minutes

ttlInference: not verified live: an env switch pins the lifetime, and no run had a real lifetime that differed from the assumed one
